versionDiscrepancy.observation: The official npm pages identify both requested published packages as 26.0.0, while the corresponding v26.0.0 Git tag source manifests contain version 24.0.0 and internal quicktype package dependency specs at 24.0.0.
versionDiscrepancy.explanation: The official v24.0.0 release notes say publishing starts from stable GitHub release tags and that release versions are stamped into npm package manifests during CI. Thus the source tag is an input to publication, not proof that the npm tarball retains the source manifest version. This publication process is consistent with and plausibly explains the 24.0.0/26.0.0 version difference. The release notes do not by themselves verify the exact contents of the 26.0.0 tarballs.
versionDiscrepancy.publishedInternalDependencyVersions: Expected to be stamped to 26.0.0 by the documented publication process; exact tarball dependency specs were not directly retrieved.

licenses.note: The two package-level Apache-2.0 declarations are visible on the official npm package pages and source manifests. A dependency-count/name listing is not a license audit.

generatorCompatibilityRisks.observation: An upstream issue reports Rust generation crashing on a valid JSON Schema boolean const and identifies quicktype-core as affected. The issue page is closed and shows no linked branch or pull request.
generatorCompatibilityRisks.candidateVersionConclusion: This issue does not establish whether quicktype-core 26.0.0 is affected or fixed. The selected-version boolean/numeric const fixture remains a required compatibility gate; do not infer pass/fail from the issue status.

selectionStatus: Audit only; quicktype 26.0.0 and quicktype-core 26.0.0 remain uninstalled and unselected. Do not freeze until exact tarball metadata, recursive licenses, and generator compatibility are reviewed.
